question: Should explicit provider-selection/config-presence metadata become part of the public realtime transcription and realtime voice `isConfigured` contexts to support providers such as Gradium?
rationale: The feature is useful and proven, but the branch changes a public Plugin SDK contract across two provider families; code review alone cannot choose that permanent external-plugin API direction.

options.title: Approve the additive SDK contract
options.body: Keep the optional metadata fields, require compatibility tests across sibling providers, fix endpoint validation, and rebase the branch.

options.title: Keep opt-in plugin-owned
options.body: Remove the shared SDK changes and express Gradium eligibility through an existing plugin-owned config or registration seam.

options.title: Do not bundle Gradium STT
options.body: Close the core PR and leave realtime Gradium transcription to an external plugin if maintainers do not want the bundled capability or SDK expansion.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional metadata fields, require compatibility tests across sibling providers, fix endpoint validation, and rebase the branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work is most closely connected to the shared Plugin SDK and provider/config boundaries that require the decision.
